rationale: The available measured evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 for P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) demonstrates a 26.8% elapsed-time reduction on a Node.js lint/typecheck workflow completing in ~41 seconds. This repository's workflow runs long-lived Unity/C++ builds (Windows, macOS, Linux, Emscripten) that likely take 30-60+ minutes per job. Without job-level duration history to set a safe timeout with operational headroom, applying a custom timeout risks false failures. The workflow already implements dependency caching (vcpkg via actions/cache@v4) for all build jobs. Other patterns in the catalogue (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) lack measured evidence in the provided evidence array and are only simulation estimates. No evidence-supported optimization fits this workflow's characteristics and constraints.
